# Inventory: Delete Transfer Lots

Area overview and notes: [inventory.md](../inventory.md)

`DELETE /transfer-lots/transactions/{transactionId}` · tenant-scoped token

Delete the Transfer Lots associated with a transfer-in ("deposit") transaction.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `transactionId` | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. |

**Response 204**: Delete Transfer Lot response

**Errors:** 400 Validation Error response that can contain either a single error message or an array of error messages. · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
